# Live probe verbs — where `kubevirt:` sits

The out-of-process check verbs (mcp/cdp/vnc/dbus/spice/adb/appium/kube/
kubevirt/…) are declarative plan steps, dispatched through the provider
registry — NOT host CLI subcommands. The bed's live plan runs them under
`charly check live` / `charly check run`. See [`/charly-check:check`](/recipes/check/check/) for the
full catalog and the plan/live/run modes.
